content: Bautisac Juan camachishcamanda
Diospa churi Jesucristomanda quishpina shimiga casnami callarishca.
Dios rimashcata ñaupa pasachic Isaias casnami quillcashca:

Chasnacpi Juanga chaquishca pambai Dios rimashcata camachisha runagunata bautisara. Pai camachisha casna nira, Dios canguna juchagunata anchuchingahuaca canguna juchata rashcagunata llaquirisha saquichi, chihuasha bautisarichi nisha camachira.

Judea provinciamandas Jerusalen llactamandahuas tucui runaguna Juanbagma shamunaura pai camachishcata uyangahua. Chita uyasha ñuca jucha rashcagunata saquinimi nicpi Juan chi Jordan nishca yacuibi bautisara.
Juanga camello nishca carata churarisha huagra carahuan ananuc ara. Sacha mishquitas chilicshina ricuriccunatas micusha causac ara.

Pai camachiusha casna rimara, Ñáucamanda huashalla shamungarauc runaga ñucamandas yali ushaiyuc man. Ñáucaga shuc mas pishi tarabac runacuinta mani. Chasna asha huascata pascangahuallas paihua zapatosta llucshichingahuas mana balicchani.
Ñáuca cangunataga yacuhuanmi bautisauni, paiga cangunata Diospa Samaihuanmi bautisanga nira.
Juan Jesusta bautisashcamanda
Chi punzhagunai Juan Jordan yacuibi bautisaura. Chasna aushcai Jesus Galilea provincia Nazaret llactamanda llucshisha shamushcai Juan paita bautisara.
Jesus yacumanda llucshiushcai jahuapacha pascarishcata ricura, Diospa Samai paihua jahuaibi shuc paloma uraicumushcacuinta tiyaric shamura.
Chasnallata jahuapachamanda shuc shimi uyarira, Can ñuca llaquishca Churi mangui, can quishpichic tucuchun nisha ñuca canda cushihuan japirani nira.
Supaiga Jesusta pandachinata munashcamanda
Chihuasha Diospa Samaiga ruyaguna illac chaquishca partima Jesusta apara.
Chi pambai chuscu chunga (40) punzha tuputa supai paita pandachinata munasha camaura. Chibimi piña sacha aichaguna tiyanaura. Chibi Diospa angelguna paita cuiranaura.
Jesus Galilea llactagunaibi camachishcamanda
Chihuasha Juanda carcelbi tapanaura. Chi uras Jesus Galilea provinciama risha Diospa ali mandanamanda cuintasha paimi quishpichinata munan nishami cushi shimita yachachira.
Casnami yachachira, Quishpina uras ña pactamushcami. Diospa ali mandanaga mayanyamushcami. Canguna juchata saquisha Dios quishpina shimita cadsusha causaichi nira.
Jesusta caticcunamanda
Galilea cucha mayanda Jesus puriusha yacu aichagunata japic ishcai (2) runagunata ricura. Chigunaga arami Simon paihua huauqui Andreshuan licata yacui shitaunaura.

Paigunata ricusha rimara, Jacu ñucahuan catihuaichi. Canguna imasna yacu aichata japishcanguichi chicuintallata cunanmanda ñaupagma runagunata japicshina tucunguichi ñucamanda yachachisha. Chasna cangunata rashami.
Chasna nicta uyasha chi ratullata licata saquisha Jesusta caticcuna tucunaura.
Pai chinicshinai riushcai Zebedeoba churi Santiagota, paihua huauqui Juandi canuaibi licata alichiucunata ricura.
Paigunata ricusha ñucahuan catihuaichi nisha rimaupi paiguna yayata tarabaccunatas canuaibi saquisha Jesusta caticcuna tucunaura.
Supai yaicushca runamanda
Chihuasha Capernaun nishca llactama rinaura. Samana punzhaibi israelguna tandarina huasibi Jesus yaicusha runagunata yachachira.

Mana chi shuc Diospa shimita yachachiccunacuinta yachachirachu, randi Diospa Samai ushaihuanmi yachachiura. Pai rimashcata uyaucuna ashcata manzharinaura, maibita chi tucuita yachara, pai yachachinaga shuc tunu man nisha rimanacunaura.
Chi tandarina huasillaita tiyaura shuc supai yaicushca runa. Pai caparingahua callarira casna nisha,

Nazaretmanda Jesus, Ñáucanchimanda anchuri, ñucanchita ama quillachichu, ñucanchita huanchisha tucuchingahuachu shamurangui. Canda ricsinchimi, canga Dios anllasha cachashca ashami jucha illac runa angui nisha caparira.
Chasna nicpi Jesus chi supaita sinzhita rimasha mandara, Chunlla ai, cai runa ucumanda llucshisha ri nira.
Jesus mandashcata uyasha supai chi runata yapa cushpachisha, sinzhita caparisha, paimanda llucshisha rira.

Chasna tucucpi chita ricuucuna yapa manzharisha paigunapura cuintanacunaura, Imasna ashata chasna riman. Jesusca shuc tunuta yachachic man, paihua shimiga ushayuc man, supaigunatas pai mandacpi paitaga cadsusha llucshinaunmi ninaura.
Chimanda intiru Galilea llactagunaibi Jesusmanda cuintanacunaura.
Jesus Pedrohua huarmi mamata alichishcamanda
Chi israel tandarina huasimanda llucshisha Jesus Santiagondi Juandi rira Simon, Andres tiyashca huasima.
Simonba huarmihua mama chibi ungushca siriura. Chasna acpi paimanda Jesusta cuintanaura.
Jesus pai siriushcai risha paihua maquimanda japisha jatarichira. Chi ratullai aliyara. Aliyasha paigunata upichingahua callarira.
Ashca ungushcagunata alichishcamanda
Chi chishillaita israel samana punzha indi yaicuushcaibi tucui ungushcagunata, supai yaicushcagunatas Jesuspagma apamunaura janbichun nisha.
Chi llactamanda yapa ashca runaguna mana cáilla chi huasi pungüi tandarinaura.
Jesus ima tunu ungushcagunatas alichira, chasnallata runaguna ucumanda supaita llucshichisha callpachira. Supaigunaga Jesusta ricsinaurami, chasna agllaita Jesusca mana munarachu paimanda rimangahua.
Jesus paihua Yayahuan cuintanacushcamanda
Cayandi gallo cantashcai Jesus jatarisha huasimanda llucshisha, runa illashca partima rira Yaya Dioshuan cuintangahua.
Ñáa pai illacpi Simon paihuan tiyaucunandi Jesusta mascangahua rinaura.
Mascasha tupanaura, tupasha paita rimanaura, Ashcagunami canda mascaunguna nisha.
Chasna rimanaupi uyasha paigunata nira, Jacuichi shuc partima, mayanlla llactagunama. Ñáuca chi llactagunaibihuas yachachina mani. Chiraicumi cai pachama shamushcani nira.
Chasna acpi puriura tucui Galilea llactagunata. Chibi auc israel tandarina huasigunai camachisha, runaguna ucumanda supaita llucshichisha puriura.
Jesus sinzhi carachayuc runata alichishcamanda
Shuc punzha shuc lepra nishca sinzhi carachayuc runa Jesuspagma shamura. Paihuacpi cungurisha paita rugara, Can munashaga ñucata janbinata ushahuangui.
Jesus paita llaquisha paihua maquihuan chi runata llangasha rimara, Munani, janbishca tucunguimi.
Pai rimashcahuan cungaimanda tucui lepra chingarira, chi runa janbishca tucura.
Chihuasha Jesus paita cachaura casna cunasha,

Ama pitas cuintanguichu, can amu yuyallai charingui. Randi israel pagrihuagma risha camba aichata ricuchigri nira. Chasnallata tucui runaguna chita yachanauchun nishaga huañuc Moises mandashcatacuinta rasha pagrima cugringui camba aicha janbirishcamanda nira.

Randi chi runa risha chunlla aunarandimandaga tucui runagunata chimanda cuintausha purira. Chiraicumanda Jesus llacta ucuma yaicunata mana usharachu, astahuanbas llacta canzhama huasi illashca partibi saquirira. Chasnacpi ashca runaguna tucui partimanda paihuagma rinaura.
